items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: オハイオ州税額控除庁が REV4, LLC に対し、シンシナティ市の事業拠点で雇用創出税額控除(JCTC、8年間2.000%)を承認。新規雇用43人・年間給与総額$4,730,000を創出する計画。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 2.000% for 8 years on 2022-07-25 for a project in the City of Cincinnati, Hamilton County. Commitment: create 43 full-time equivalent employees generating $4,730,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.
